description: This source file implements a command-line tool for verifying and analyzing WPEFramework shared libraries and files. It includes functions for parsing command-line options, loading shared libraries, reading directories and files, and printing information about loaded modules.

methods.name: ParseOptions
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine load locations and options.

methods.name: ReadFile
methods.description: Loads a shared library file and prints its module name and build reference if available.

methods.name: ReadDirectory
methods.description: Recursively reads a directory, processing each file or subdirectory.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point of the program, orchestrating the parsing, directory traversal, and cleanup.
